description: The TWAIN project publishes synthetic inflow profiles and wind-farm simulation outputs used in a wind-response study. Zenodo lists one text reconstruction guide and five public parts of a split archive under CC BY 4.0. The provider names two databases, SyntheticInflowProfileDatabase and SimulationOutputDatabase, generated for its task on farm response. These can benchmark wind-farm response or serve as scenario inputs when testing reduced-order or multi-stakeholder energy models. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this two-database release. A limitation is that the five parts together are about 162 GiB and must be combined before their internal structure can be inspected; this metadata review did not obtain them. The public guide gives an integrity checksum but does not enumerate columns, plants or model parameters, so transfer costs remain high. Synthetic inflows and outputs are not observations of real farms. No archive part was downloaded or checksum verified, and no response curve was reproduced.
